projects.name: MoDOT STIP (BusinessInt/STIP)
projects.notes: Statewide Transportation Improvement Program, state fiscal years 2027-2031 (SFY), so every record is planned. No work-type or status field: the work is in the free-text DESCRIPTION; IS_BRIDGE is Y/N. ESTIMATED_COST and BRIDGES_COST are padded text with commas, not numbers.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Missouri.

parcels_counties.notes: On the St. Louis County GIS ArcGIS Online organisation, whole county (399,685 parcels), but the sample record is tax year 2020 (TAXYR), so ownership may be several years old. Newer but partial layers exist in the same organisation (e.g. Parcels_1LivUnit/FeatureServer/27, TAXYR 2024, single-unit residential only, 114,310 records, same field names unshortened).
Third-party copy on ArcGIS Online, data dated 2020-03 in the sample; includes four previous owners and sale history. The county's own server (map.sccmo.org) timed out.

Published by the City of Parkville (item 0ef0d612f9a14424ab63f91f91615ea6, titled 'Parkville Parcels 2024') but the layer extent and the 45,056 records cover all of Platte County: parcels taxed in 2024. Terms read on the item 2026-11-18: 'Users are granted permission to use, copy, and distribute the data for personal, educational, or commercial purposes, provided attribution is given to the City of Parkville and/or Platte County as appropriate'; the rest is a warranty and liability disclaimer. Attribution is required. DEEDHOLD_1 is a second holder; Mailing__2/3/4 are city, state, ZIP. Current-value fields (Curr_Total) are present. maxRecordCount 2000.

Jasper County GIS account (JascoGIS), item ee8439f9194f421db8faa5d0b00396c7, 'Jasper County Land Parcels for Taxing Purposes'. Terms read on the item 2026-11-18: a warranty and liability disclaimer only ('for convenience only ... provided "as is" with no warranties of any kind'); no limit on commercial use, redistribution or mailing stated. Own_Addres is one string with street, city, state and ZIP separated by semicolons. The item was last modified in June 2022, so ownership may be dated. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found (the item licence field and the layer description are empty; the county's own terms page was not located on 2026-11-18)
parcels_counties.notes: Clay County, MO GIS account (clayco_gisadmin), item 37dd84175f9b4568b3daf1892a586d3c: 'Clay County, MO GIS Parcels Data with Parcel ID, Owner names, Situs, Mailing Address, and Taxing Districts'. Item modified in 2026. co_owner holds a second name or 'ETAL'/'TRUST'. No value field. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found (served by the City of Springfield GIS server; the service carries only the credit 'City of Springfield GIS' and no terms; no terms page was located on 2026-11-18)
parcels_counties.notes: 'Parcels Greene' layer on the City of Springfield server: county assessor attributes for all 123,884 Greene County parcels. OWN2 is a second owner, CAREOF a care-of line; ADRNO/ADRSTR/CITYNAME/STATECODE/ZIP1 are the owner's mailing address and the L_ fields the property location. maxRecordCount 1000. The same server has 'Parcels Christian' (layer 20, 36,132 parcels) with a name field but no mailing address.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Jackson (jcgis.jacksongov.org timed out), St. Louis City, Greene.
summary: Projects: MoDOT STIP lines for SFY 2027-2031 verified (description and cost, no work-type or status field). Parcels: no statewide owner layer; St. Louis County and St. Charles County layers verified but both look like 2020 data; Added 2026-11-18: Platte (commercial use expressly allowed) and Jasper (disclaimer only) verified; Clay and Greene verified but no terms found. Jackson, St. Louis City, Jefferson and Boone still not found (their servers did not answer or publish no owner layer).
